title: WHAT IF YOU COULD PAUSE EVERYONE ELSE?

segments.line: Steal the last cookie right off the plate.
Freeze your friend Mo before he spills his drink.
Even pause Mum before she sees the mess.
What if you could pause everyone else on Earth?
At first, it feels like a superpower.
Walk past The Suit into any restricted room.
Finish your homework while the whole world waits.
Nap for six hours on a busy staircase.
Until you realize one terrifying physics catch.
If air molecules are frozen solid around you,
you couldn't breathe, and light couldn't reach your eyes.
Every step would feel like slamming into concrete.
Now everyone stares as you appear out of thin air,
holding a cookie you definitely didn't pay for.
